g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud security operations with Security Command Center, Cloud NGFW and automated remediation

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Cloud NGFW Enterprise inspects the web VMs' traffic and blocks known exploits
An organisation sink gathers threat, audit and flow logs from every project
A log-based metric counts blocked threats
and an alert policy notifies the SOC channel when they spike
Analysts query the linked BigQuery dataset to investigate
Security Command Center publishes a high-severity finding: a bucket made public
The function removes the public binding and marks the finding resolved
A Cloud Asset feed reports every IAM policy change in the folder
and a function flags grants of owner or editor to the SOC
